units.source_text: 白居易《冬至宿杨梅馆》诗云：“十一月中长至夜，

en.t: A poem by Bai Juyi, "Staying at Yangmei Lodge on the Winter Solstice," says: "In mid-eleventh month, on the long winter solstice night,
a traveler is far away, three thousand li from home.

units.source_text: 若为独宿杨梅馆，冷枕单床一病身。”

en.t: How can he bear to sleep alone at Yangmei Lodge, with a cold pillow, a single bed, and one sick body?"
